item.text: The pager stops when it receives fewer active records than the page size, but deleted records can make a page short even when more records remain. I’ll make it follow the gateway’s continuation cursor. Projects use a larger scan size, which masks this issue for small collections.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Pagination now continues until the gateway returns a null cursor, so deleted records no longer truncate exports. The reported case now includes both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Added regression coverage for short pages, fully deleted pages, and empty cursor tokens. All 5 tests pass with `node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/export.test.ts`.
